an3.64:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
an3.64:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Sarabho nāma paribbājako acirapakkanto hoti imasmā dhammavinayā.
an3.64:1.4: So Rājagahe parisatiṃ evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati --
an3.64:1.6: aññāya ca panāhaṃ samaṇānaṃ Sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammaṃ evāhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkanto ti. 2.
an3.64:1.7: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pavisiṃsu.
an3.64:1.8: Assosuṃ kho te bhikkhū Sarabhassa paribbājakassa Rājagahe parisatiṃ evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānassa --
an3.64:1.10: aññāya ca panāhaṃ samaṇānaṃ Sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammaṃ evāhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkanto ti.
an3.64:2.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū Rājagahe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu. Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
an3.64:2.2: Sarabho nāma bhante paribbājako acirapakkanto imasmā dhammavinayā.
an3.64:2.3: So Rājagahe parisatiṃ evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati --
an3.64:2.5: aññāya ca panāhaṃ samaṇānaṃ Sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammaṃ evāhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkanto ti.
an3.64:2.6: Sādhu bhante Bhagavā yena Sappinikātīraṃ yena paribbājakārāmo yena Sarabho paribbājako ten' upasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti.
an3.64:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yena Sappinikātīraṃ yena paribbājakārāmo yena Sarabho paribbājako ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi, nisajja kho Bhagavā Sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etad avoca:
an3.64:3.2: Saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Sarabha evaṃ vadesi --
an3.64:3.4: aññāya ca panāhaṃ samaṇānaṃ Sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammaṃ evāhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkanto ti.
an3.64:3.5: Evaṃ vutte Sarabho paribbājako tuṇhī ahosi.
an3.64:4.1: Dutiyam pi kho Bhagavā Sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.64:4.2: Vadehi Sarabha kinti te aññāto samaṇānaṃ Sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammo.
an3.64:4.3: Sace te aparipūraṃ bhavissati ahaṃ paripūressāmi.
an3.64:4.4: Sace pana te paripūraṃ bhavissati ahaṃ anumodissāmī ti.
an3.64:4.5: Dutiyam pi kho Sarabho paribbājako tuṇhī ahosi.
an3.64:5.1: Tatiyam pi kho Bhagavā Sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.64:5.2: Mayā kho Sarabha paññāyati samaṇānaṃ Sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammo. Vadehi Sarabha kinti te aññāto samaṇānaṃ Sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammo.
an3.64:5.3: Sace te aparipūraṃ bhavissati ahaṃ paripūressāmi.
an3.64:5.4: Sace pana te paripūraṃ bhavissati ahaṃ anumodissāmī ti.
an3.64:5.5: Tatiyam pi kho Sarabho paribbājako tuṇhī ahosi. 4.
an3.64:6.1: Atha kho te paribbājakā Rājagahakā Sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ etad avocuṃ:--
an3.64:6.2: Yad eva kho tvaṃ āvuso samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ yāceyyāsi tad eva te samaṇo Gotamo pavāreti.
an3.64:6.3: Vadeh' āvuso Sarabha kinti te aññāto samaṇānaṃ Sakyaputtiyānaṃ dhammo.
an3.64:6.4: Sace te aparipūraṃ bhavissati samaṇo Gotamo paripūressati.
an3.64:6.5: Sace pana te paripūraṃ bhavissati samaṇo Gotamo anumodissatī ti.
an3.64:6.6: Evaṃ vutte Sarabho paribbājako tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdi. 5.
an3.64:7.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ maṅkubhūtaṃ pattakkhandhaṃ adhomukhaṃ pajjhāyantaṃ appaṭibhānaṃ viditvā te paribbājake etad avoca:
an3.64:8.1: Yo kho maṃ paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyya --
an3.64:8.2: sammāsambuddhassa te paṭijānato ime dhammā anabhisambuddhā ti -- tam ahaṃ tattha sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjeyyaṃ samanugāheyyaṃ samanubhāseyyaṃ.
an3.64:8.3: So vata mayā sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ so tiṇṇaṃ ṭhānānaṃ nāññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ nigaccheyya -- aññena vā aññaṃ paṭicarissati bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmessati kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukarissati, tuṇhībhūto vā maṅkubhūto vā pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdissati seyyathāpi Sarabho paribbājako.
an3.64:9.1: Yo kho maṃ paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyya --
an3.64:9.2: khīṇāsavassa te paṭijānato ime āsavā aparikkhīṇā ti -- taṃ ahaṃ tattha sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjeyyaṃ samanugāheyyaṃ samanubhāseyyaṃ.
an3.64:9.3: So vata mayā sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ so tiṇṇaṃ ṭhānānaṃ nāññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ nigaccheyya -- aññena vā aññaṃ paṭicarissati bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmessati kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukarissati tuṇhībhūto vā maṅkubhūto vā pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdissati seyyathāpi Sarabho paribbājako.
an3.64:10.1: Yo kho maṃ paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyya --
an3.64:10.2: yassa kho pana te atthāya dhammo desito so na niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāyā ti -- tam ahaṃ tattha sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjeyyaṃ samanugāheyyaṃ samanubhāseyyaṃ.
an3.64:10.3: So vata mayā sādhukaṃ samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno aṭṭhānam etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ so tiṇṇaṃ ṭhānānaṃ nāññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ nigaccheyya -- aññena vā aññaṃ paṭicarissati bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmessati kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātukarissati, tuṇhībhūto vā maṅkubhūto vā pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdissati seyyathāpi Sarabho paribbājako ti.
an3.64:10.4: Atha kho Bhagavā Sappinikā-tīre paribbājakārāme tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ naditvā vehāsaṃ pakkāmi. 6.
an3.64:11.1: Atha kho te paribbājakā acirapakkantassa Bhagavato Sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ samantato vācāya sannitodakena sañjambhariṃ akaṃsu.
an3.64:11.2: Seyyathāpi āvuso Sarabha brahāraññe jarasigālo sīhanādaṃ nadissāmī ti segālakaṃ yeva nadati bheraṇḍakaṃ yeva nadati,
an3.64:11.3: evam eva kho tvaṃ āvuso Sarabha, aññatr' eva samaṇena Gotamena sīhanādaṃ nadissāmī ti, segālakaṃ yeva nadasi bheraṇḍakaṃ yeva nadasi.
an3.64:11.4: Seyyathāpi āvuso Sarabha ambakamaddarī phussakaravitaṃ ravissāmī ti ambakamaddariravitaṃ yeva ravati,
an3.64:11.5: evam eva kho taṃ āvuso Sarabho aññatr' eva samaṇena Gotamena phussakaravitaṃ ravissāmī ti ambakamaddariravitaṃ yeva ravasi.
an3.64:11.6: Seyyathāpi āvuso Sarabha usabho suññāya gosālāya gambhīraṃ naditabbaṃ maññati,
an3.64:11.7: evam eva kho tvaṃ āvuso Sarabha aññatr' eva samaṇena Gotamena gambhīraṃ naditabbaṃ maññasī ti.
an3.64:11.8: Atha kho te paribbājakā Sarabhaṃ paribbājakaṃ samantato vācāya sannitodakena sañjambharim akaṃsū
